# Client Request: Claims Portal, remaining release types (synthetic fixture)

This is a synthetic fixture for the release-series flow with the enabler, segment cutover and already built types; no real client is behind it.

We want a claims portal for our policyholders and our back office. The goal is to cut the time a claim takes from filing to registration.

The main users are policyholders, who file their claims, and back office adjusters, who register them.

In scope: online claim filing with attachments. In scope: online filing switched on for motor claims first, while the other claims run in shadow. Out of scope: claim payment and fraud scoring.

We expect online filing to reach 60 percent of all claims within two quarters.

The claim intake desk already runs today, and its intake rules are written down.
